main.description: A vote on a trail detail suggestion (app.activitytracker.feed.trailDetailSuggestion), or a confirmation of a segment's trail detail as it was in effect (segments/trail-detail-suggestions). Private: stored only in the voter's interactions space, and the AppView ignores one in a repo or a tier space. It counts only while the voter has an effort on the segment, and a confirmation only while the value it names is still in effect. The AppView never serves who voted.

subject.description: The suggestion, at the version voted on, with direction up or down. Absent for a confirmation.

detail.description: For a confirmation: the detail, as feed.trailDetailSuggestion#detail.

value.description: For a confirmation: the detail's value in effect, holding only its fields.

direction.description: up or down on a suggestion; still (still right) or changed on a value in effect. Any other value is ignored.
